answer: Each attestation tx carries a witness set - the txids it countersigned - and the engine clusters identities by witness overlap: accounts co-signing the same txs are kin. When a duplicate answer is caught, the cluster's pending rewards burn together, kin-linked collateral, a meadow fire moved by one spark. The escape is isolation per fake: distinct key history, its own wander through the pool, no shared countersignatures - fresh compute per sybil. One bridge between clusters burns the ember of pending payout on both sides; the fingerprint stays on-ledger, so detection gets cheaper each epoch.
